fields.description: Display name for this connection, e.g. Production OpenAI or Local Ollama.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: LiteLLM connector used by this connection. Custom is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
fields.label: Connector

fields.description: API key for this connection. Leave empty for local servers that don't require authentication.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Generic endpoint fallback. Custom connections require this or at least one operation-specific Base URL.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object of connector-specific kwargs merged into every call. A model's own params take precedence.
fields.label: Extra Params

fields.description: Default chat API for models linked to this connection. Auto uses Responses for direct official OpenAI connections and LiteLLM defaults for proxies, Custom and other connectors.
fields.label: Default API Style

fields.description: Endpoint used for Chat Completions calls before falling back to Base URL.
fields.label: Chat Completions Base URL

fields.description: Endpoint used for Responses calls before falling back to Base URL.
fields.label: Responses Base URL

fields.description: Endpoint used for embeddings before falling back to Base URL. Chat API Style does not affect embeddings.
fields.label: Embeddings Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object of additional HTTP headers. Authentication headers are reserved.
fields.label: Extra Headers

fields.description: Optional JSON object of additional query parameters. Routing and authentication keys are reserved.
fields.label: Extra Query

fields.description: Optional JSON object merged into the OpenAI-compatible request body. Message, tool, routing and authentication keys are reserved.
fields.label: Extra Body
